sn52.12:1.1: imesañca panā’haṃ āvuso, catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhomi: “ekopi hutvā bahudhā homi, bahudhā’pi hutvā eko homi, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchāmi seyyathāpi ākāse. paṭhaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ karomi seyyathāpi udake. udake’pi abhejjamāne gacchāmi seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ. ākāse’pi pallaṅkena kamāmi seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo. ime’pi candimasuriye evammahiddhike evammahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasāmi parimajjāmi. yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vattemī”ti.
